title: Resistant Polish
description: Resistant Polish lets players apply a degradable, configurable explosion-resistance coating to individual blocks, allowing structures to partially survive blasts without becoming permanently indestructible.
body:
Ever wished your builds could fight back against explosions instead of instantly turning into debris? Resistant Polish adds a brand-new block reinforcement system that lets you polish blocks to make them more explosion-resistant—without turning the game into pure creative mode chaos.

This mod introduces a simple but satisfying progression where blocks can be treated, measured, reused, and even stripped of their polish when needed.

**Polishing System:
**
Resistant Polish adds multiple polish items that can be applied directly to blocks:

Slightly Resistant Polish – A small boost to resistance
Resistant Polish – A solid, balanced increase
Very Resistant Polish – Maximum protection potential

(_All of these values are configurable_) Each application increases a block’s Polish Resistance (up to a cap of 100). The higher the value, the better the block can survive explosions.

Polished blocks have a chance to survive with the higher the polish value, the better the odds. Surviving blocks lose some resistance over time.

**Utility Items**:

To help manage polish, the mod adds a couple of handy tools:

🟠 Copper Polish Gauger
Right-click a block to see its current polish value
Stores and displays the last scanned value
🧽 Sponge Polish Remover
Removes all polish from a block
Gives you Leftover Resistant Polish, which can be reused (at reduced strength)

🧪 **Leftover Polish**
Can be reapplied to blocks
Restores a weakened version of the original resistance

⚙️ **Configurable & Server-Friendly**:

     Fully configurable polish values with server-side decay settings for fine balance control. Resistance data is saved per world and automatically cleared when a block is broken.
